narr: An ice jam formed on the Kankakee River near Wilmington during the morning of February 17th producing localized flash flooding near the river.
ev: An ice jam formed on the Kankakee River near the Interstate 55 bridge. This ice jam caused localized flash flooding near the river, downstream of Wilmington.
lsr: WILL COUNTY EMERGENCY MANAGER CONFIRMS ICE JAM CAUSING FLOODING ON THE KANKAKEE RIVER NEAR I-55 DOWNSTREAM OF WILMINGTON.
RIVER ICE SPOTTER REPORTS ICE JAM CAUSING FLOODING ABOUT 2 MILES DOWNSTREAM OF WILMINGTON. ALSO NOTES LARGE PIECES OF ICE AND WATER FLOWING OVER ICE.
WILL COUNTY EMERGENCY MANAGER REPORTS ICE JAM NEAR I-55 HAS BROKEN UP, CAUSING A RAPID RIVER RISE DOWNSTREAM.
